name: Pan Ananapibut
detail: 2012 presentation titled "ภาษีความมั่งคั่ง" actually proposed a Korean-style property/land and building tax on housing above 5 million THB rather than a net wealth tax on total assets minus debt.

name: Sommai Phasee
detail: Former Finance Minister (2014–2015) who enacted the 2015 Inheritance Tax Act and Land and Building Tax Act; while frequently referred to in media as taxing the wealthy, these are inheritance and real property taxes excluded under Section 2.
